observations: Photo 0, 1, 2 show a dismantled automatic transmission/gearbox assembly, heavily dirty/oily, resting on a workshop floor.
A starter motor and wiring harness connectors are visible attached to the bellhousing in photos 0 and 1.
No manufacturer logo, part number plate, or VIN/ID tag is legible in any photo.
A watermark 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' overlays all three photos; no other text is visible.
Blue paint marker dot visible on the casing in photos 0 and 2, likely a yard/stock marking, not a brand identifier.
No shots of the gearbox being tested (shaft rotation, fluid, or bench test) are included.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: General business claim about the seller's stock; not specific to this item and not shown in any photo.

claims.claim: Implied this gearbox is a genuine Japanese-make part (by context of seller's business description)
claims.evidence: No plate, stamping, or casting mark naming a brand or model is visible in photo 0, 1, or 2.

risks.risk: Unknown vehicle make/model/year fitment, which drives most of the price for a used gearbox
risks.proof: Clear photo of the ID/part-number tag or casting number stamped on the casing, or seller's statement of exact donor vehicle with a matching photo
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced even at worst case, since price range across models is too wide

risks.risk: Internal condition unknown — could be seized, grinding, or leaking internally despite clean exterior photos
risks.proof: Video clip showing input/output shaft rotating freely and smoothly, or a bench test clip

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history and reason for removal (accident, failure, scrap) unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the donor vehicle or odometer, or a written service/removal history
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, same as for-parts condition

risks.risk: Missing or damaged connectors/sensors could add hidden repair cost
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all wiring connectors and sensor ports showing they are intact and unbroken

risks.risk: Fluid condition/contamination (metal shavings, burnt smell) cannot be seen in static photos
risks.proof: Photo or video of drained fluid on a white tray
risks.if_unproven: priced as fluid unknown, worst case fluid contaminated

proof_requests: Clear photo of the ID/part-number tag or casting number stamped on the gearbox housing
Statement and photo proof of the exact donor vehicle make, model, and year this gearbox was pulled from
Video clip showing the output/input shaft turning freely without grinding or resistance
Close-up photos of all electrical connectors to confirm none are broken or missing
Photo of drained transmission fluid condition
response.reason: The gearbox cannot even be priced at a worst-case floor without knowing which vehicle it fits, since used-gearbox prices vary enormously by make and model, and no plate or tag naming the fitment is legible in any photo.
